about: Claims modeled on a sample of a Claim (or ExplanationOfBenefit) on its own: one per claim written, its items repeated per claim line, taken in turn from the sample's claims and items. The patient, coverage and providers it refers to are the sample's references. A Bundle with a Patient and a Claim is fhir-claims.json.
subject: claims

member.about: Whose values a place's suggestion is for: the resource this file repeats.

units.name: claim
units.missing: The sample has no Claim or ExplanationOfBenefit to model claims on.

derive.about: Every resource written is a new one: a new id, and every reference to it follows.
The narrative describes the sample's resource, not the one written.
A claim's items are numbered from 1.
Claim.total is its items' net added up, when the sample's claim has a total.
